title: What to expect at your first volunteering drive · AquaTerra
description: What to bring and what to expect at your first AquaTerra drive: biscuits for dogs, affirmation notes, bags for clothes and more. {count} drives since {firstYear}.
lede: For most first drives, bring the one thing the drive is built around: biscuits for a feeding drive, affirmation notes and toffees for Smile Notes, or bags for a clothes collection. AquaTerra has written up {count} drives since {firstYear}, at {placesCount} places across the city.

sections.heading: what a first drive looks like
body: Most drives on this page are one of three kinds: feeding stray dogs, handing things out in a neighbourhood, or collecting clothes and books. Tails and Treats feeds dogs and sometimes cows with biscuits, at places such as Bangur, Salt Lake and Howrah. Smile Notes hands affirmation notes and toffees to passersby. Wear and Share and Book Basket collect clothes and books, and Sharbat Seva handed out cooling sharbat in the summer heat.

Many drives are short. The April 2026 feeding drive at Dobson Lane is described as a successful hour, with volunteers feeding dogs and cows during it. Lengths vary, and each write-up gives the place and the date, so you can see what a short drive looked like before you go.

sections.heading: what to bring
body: Bring what the drive is built around, and check with the team before you buy anything, so the drive has one list rather than five. For a feeding drive, that means biscuits. One Tails and Treats drive at Laketown in September 2025 reports ninety dogs fed, and the team's biscuits were the whole plan.

For Smile Notes, bring the affirmation notes and the toffees, which go out in pairs: a hundred notes and a hundred toffees at Bhawanipore and at MBA Chaiwala in March 2026, with a toffee given out for every note. For clothes and books, bring bags and expect the weight to add up. Wear and Share drives in July 2025 collected from five to fifteen kilograms of clothes each, and Book Basket drives in June 2025 gathered books from housing complexes and other spots. For food, Food For All handed out bananas in April 2025, and the Sharbat Seva drives that month served sharbat made with Rooh Afza.

sections.heading: what you do on the day
body: The work is hands-on and simple: feeding, handing out, collecting and packing. At a Smile Notes drive, a volunteer hands a note and a toffee to each passerby, and the write-up for a March 2026 drive at Bhawanipore describes passersby having their day brightened by small acts of kindness.

The write-ups keep returning to the animals and the children. The Tails and Treats drive at Howrah in September 2025 describes students who dished out love and food to every furry friend they met, and the feeding drives at Bangur and Salt Lake in 2025 were all about the same simple routine of feeding.

sections.heading: after the drive
body: Write the drive up the same week: the place, how many of you went, what you handed out and what it came to. Every AquaTerra drive is written up on the site, so the next volunteer can see what a first drive at that place involved.

Go back when a place works. The Tails and Treats drives returned to Bangur, Salt Lake and Howrah again and again in 2025, and the Wear and Share collections ran at places around Salt Lake and Laketown. A regular place makes the second visit easier than the first.

learnings: Bring the one thing the drive is built around, such as biscuits for dogs, notes and toffees, or bags for clothes.
Ask the team what it needs before you buy anything, so the drive has one list.
A first drive can be a short visit, and the series that return to one place show how a routine forms.
The places that come back, like Bangur and Salt Lake, are the easiest to join for a second time.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first volunteering drive in Kolkata?
faqs.a: Bring the one thing the drive is built around: biscuits for a stray dog feeding drive, affirmation notes and toffees for Smile Notes, or bags for a clothes collection. Check the list with the team first, since AquaTerra has written up {count} drives since {firstYear}, each with its own supplies.

faqs.q: What do volunteers actually do at an AquaTerra drive?
faqs.a: Volunteers feed dogs, hand out notes, sharbat, food and toffees, and collect clothes and books. Teams are usually small, and each write-up says what the drive handed out and how many children or animals it reached.

faqs.q: Where do AquaTerra's drives take place?
faqs.a: The drives on this page took place at {placesCount} places, from Bangur, Salt Lake and Howrah to Bhawanipore, Lake Town and Avani Oxford. Each write-up names the place.

faqs.q: How do I join AquaTerra to volunteer?
faqs.a: Members of AquaTerra are aged fourteen to nineteen. To join, sign in with Google and wait for approval, and the join page has the steps.

faqs.q: How long does an AquaTerra drive take?
faqs.a: Some drives are short. The April 2026 feeding drive at Dobson Lane is described as a successful hour, and the write-up for each drive gives its place and date so you know what to expect.
